reviews.author: CinemaSerf
reviews.content: With the handover of Hong Kong from the UK to China already largely agreed, nobody in the territory wants any complications at this late stage in the day. Well sadly that's exactly what the Organised Crime department of the Royal Hong Kong Police Force gets when the tenth uncle of the legendary “Poon” family is kidnapped. It's patriarch, “Sir William” (Gardner Tse Kwan-Ho) isn't a man to be messed with and so swiftly superintendent “M.B” (Terrance Lau Chun-Hin) is drafted in to try and rescue the man before the HK$600 millions is paid for what is more than likely to end up being a corpse! What this honourable cop and his team don’t know is that the heir to the “Poon” family - “Simon” (Wu Kang-ren) is up to some illicit scheming of his own and, of course, the Triads are also positioning themselves for the new regime too. When “M.B.” finds himself caught up in the middle of not just these intrigues but also of some duplicitous internal machinations, he has to go rogue to keep himself safe and hopefully get to the bottom of this politically-charged mystery. Terrance Lau is on decent form here and the production entertainingly integrates the plentiful CGI with the live-action quite well too as the story taps into themes of greed, betrayal, family power plays and police corruption whilst keeping us well clear of any romantic interludes. The plot has it's fair share of twists and turns at the beginning, but the ending is rushed and perhaps just a little too predicable as a perfectly good Rolls Royce is blown to smithereens and the death-defying becomes more the rule than the exception. It's worth a watch, but is disappointingly episodic throughout and lacks for much originality.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In 1994 Hong Kong, a high-profile tycoon kidnapping threatens the city's financial stability while exposing deep-seated corruption and personal greed within the police force.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a prominent tycoon is kidnapped in 1994, the financial foundation of Hong Kong is pushed to the brink of crisis. Instead of uniting to solve the crime, various factions within the police force prioritize personal gain and political maneuvering over public safety. Amidst the chaos, OCID Superintendent Li Wenbin steps forward to confront these conflicting interests. Risking his career and life, Li launches a dangerous investigation to uncover the internal sabotage and bring the true perpetrators to justice.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the critical transitional year of 1994, Hong Kong is thrown into turmoil when a powerful billionaire tycoon is brazenly kidnapped. The high-stakes crime sends shockwaves through the global market, threatening to destabilize Hong Kong's position as a secure international financial hub. As the public demands answers, internal fractures within the police department quickly begin to surface. Rather than focusing on rescuing the hostage, high-ranking officers manipulate the crisis to pursue personal promotions and wealth. Witnessing the moral collapse of his peers, Organized Crime and Triad Bureau (OCID) Superintendent Li Wenbin decides to take control of the volatile situation. Li must navigate a treacherous web of political bureaucracy, systemic corruption, and hidden agendas to find the kidnappers. As his investigation deepens, he realizes the conspiracy reaches much higher into the administrative ranks than he initially anticipated. With time running out for both the hostage and the city's reputation, Li orchestrates a daring counter-operation. He faces immense pressure from compromised superiors who want the investigation shut down permanently. Ultimately, Li risks everything in a final, dangerous confrontation to expose the truth and restore integrity to the department.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the tense political backdrop of mid-1990s Hong Kong, this gripping crime drama follows the chaotic aftermath of a prominent tycoon's kidnapping. The incident triggers a massive internal power struggle within the police force, where the pursuit of justice is heavily compromised by institutional greed and personal ambition. As the city's financial standing hangs in the balance, a principled Superintendent from the Organized Crime and Triad Bureau must risk his life and career to navigate a web of deception, outmaneuver corrupt colleagues, and expose a far-reaching conspiracy.
